meta.title: Sign up, sign in and join a team

messages.label: referredBy + 15% first-month offer

Format, 8/IP, Turnstile, 3/email

10/IP limit, rules, live token?

messages.label: ok + new session
messages.note: Seat-paused member → 403 disabled, no session

messages.note: From the Thakeen invite email, or a link the inviter copied

Log out first to accept invite

messages.label: POST /api/team/accept {token}

messages.label: 30/IP limit; peekInvite
messages.note: Unexpired, owner active, inviter still owner or enabled admin

messages.label: Invalid, expired or used invite

messages.note: Email fixed by the invite; Join is marked disabled until the rules pass

messages.label: 10/IP limit, live invite, password

messages.label: Free seat? Address not a login?
messages.note: Under lock:team and lock:login; seats: founder count, else plan (Business and Agency 7) · 409 seats / unavailable

messages.label: Write member:, delete the invite
messages.note: acceptedAt = sessionsAfter = now; added to roster; single use

messages.label: New session, bell item for owner
messages.note: No trial credits, referral code or signup tracking

messages.label: Inside the account, role chip
messages.note: No brand yet: admin → first-login game, member → wait note

messages.label: No free seat, or email has login
messages.note: Also too many attempts, or back to the invalid-invite screen

messages.label: Read session and sessionsAfter
messages.note: 30 days (2 h impersonation, which also ends with its console key session), then Redis TTL removes it

messages.label: currentUser() returns null
messages.note: Reset elsewhere, suspended, member removed, left or paused

messages.label: Login page, no warning
messages.note: Suspended → suspended text · removed member → "Wrong email or password." · seat-paused member → seat-paused text

cards.title: Refusals and limits
items: Signup: 5 per IP per hour; every attempt counts; Turnstile when both keys are set
Login: 20 per IP and 8 per email per 15 min; no lockout
Forgot: 8 per IP, 3 per email per 15 min; still answers ok
Reset 10, invite check 30, accept 10 per IP per 15 min
Wrong password shows "Wrong email or password."; rate limit and seat pause have their own text

cards.title: Who can do this
items: Owner: Activate Noor and View plans lead to billing
Admin and member: ask-the-owner text, a single OK
MCP menu entry: owner only, off while a founder impersonates; Partner entry: approved partners
Joining: signed out, a live 7-day invite and a free seat (founder's count, else Trial 3, Starter 1, Pro 3, Business and Agency 7)
A founder can extend a trial by 1-90 days

cards.title: While the model is paused
items: Signup makes no model call, so the pause does not touch it
Generate says "Content generation is paused for now. No credits were used."
Chat after the trial ended answers trial-ended first; inside the trial it gives its paused reply
Item image, video and an added brand's setup still raise the trial dialog; onboarding from /start answers "paused"
